description.value: Table: Summon Nature's Ally IX Creature Subtype(s) Adamantoise (1/day Breath and Earthquake) (Reptilian) Pixie — Sand Worm (1/day Earthquake) — Sea Worm (1/day Aqualung) (Aquatic) Thunder Gigas (1/day Earthquake and Lightning Roar) (Lightning, Giant) This spell functions like Summon Nature’s Ally I , except that you can summon one creature from the 9th-level list with a CR rating of 14 or lower, 1d3 creatures of the same kind from the 8th-level list , or 1d4+1 creatures of the same kind from the 7th-level or lower lists.
